page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highmem-80 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance featuring 80 dedicated vCPUs and 640 GB of system memory. Operating with a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, this instance provides elevated memory density alongside wide multi-core parallel processing capacity for intensive compute environments.

The hardware configuration does not include local disk storage, dedicated graphics accelerators, or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Persistent block storage and external network access must be configured through compatible cloud networking and storage services, aligning operational costs to provisioned storage volume rather than bundled local media.

With its 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation, the instance provides high resource density for workloads constrained by RAM capacity. It serves environments such as in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data analytics pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highmem-80 is a memory-oriented virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 80 dedicated vCPUs and 640 GB of system RAM, it maintains an elevated allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core. This configuration provides high parallel processing capacity alongside deep system memory capacity. The instance contains no bundled local disk storage and includes zero GPUs, utilizing attached persistent disks for filesystem operations and operating system hosting. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Designed to handle large working datasets directly in memory, the n4d-highmem-80 is tailored for in-memory databases, large-scale caching systems, enterprise software, big data processing frameworks, and distributed analytics tasks that demand substantial memory volume without physical hardware accelerators.
